description: JamBase brings live music data into ChatGPT so you can find shows worth your time without juggling ten different ticketing sites. Search concerts and festivals by artist, venue, city, genre, or date with quick shortcuts like "this weekend" or "next weekend." Track when your favorite bands are touring near you, plan trips around festival lineups, find music livestreams, and ask questions like "what's worth seeing in Brooklyn this weekend?" or "are Phish or Khruangbin touring near Chicago this fall?" Answers are grounded in JamBase's catalog of events from dozens of ticketing and venue sources, updated continuously.
